messages:
morgan: Heads-up: we're changing websocket streaming frames to include `chunk_id` and `eos` fields in v2. This will break clients that parse by positional fields. Need a short-term plan: shim sidecar vs server-side fallback? cc @alex @priya

alex: Long-term i still prefer server-side fallback for hosted API, but short-term a sidecar translation layer buys us time for Dedicated/Private. Keeps runtime unchanged.

priya: Important note: telemetry + billing pipelines depend on exact token-boundary detection in current frames. Any shim must preserve token counts and timing metrics or we'll skew invoices.

sam: Quick idea: an envoy lua filter can translate old->new frames on the fly. Prototype below (very rough):
```lua
function envoy_on_response(response_handle)
  local body = response_handle:body():getBytes(0, response_handle:body():length())
  local t = cjson.decode(body)
  if t and t.content then
    -- inject monotonic chunk_id and map trailing newline to eos
    t.chunk_id = tostring(math.random(1,1e9))
    t.eos = t.content:match("\n$") ~= nil
    response_handle:body():setBytes(0, cjson.encode(t))
  end
end
```

jules: Also watch function-calling/tooling: v2 adds structured `tool` frames. Shim must preserve tool call boundaries and not mangle JSON.

alex: Agreed. Implementation idea: conservative shim that only adds `chunk_id` and `eos` and otherwise passes payload through. Map `eos=true` -> stream close. Need to keep idempotency keys for replay safety.

priya: Can we gate the shim behind a per-tenant feature flag? I want a canary at 5% then 25% before wide rollout. Also add telemetry diff checks to catch billing drift.

deploy-bot: Feature flag created: `ff/websocket-frame-v2-bridge` (created by morgan) :white_check_mark:

morgan: Plan sounds good. Action items: Sam builds envoy-lua prototype, Priya wires feature flag and telemetry checks, Jules writes test plan + integration with replay logs, Alex drafts header negotiation for longer-term opt-in. Schedule a 5% canary next Tue. I'll open a ticket and link RFC follow-up.

jules: Test checklist (high level): unit mapping tests for a variety of frame shapes, integration test with historical replay data, e2e with Private deployment snapshot, perf regression <2% latency. Also include a fuzz test for malformed frames.

alex: One more thing: add server-side negotiation header `X-RW-Stream-Version` so clients can explicitly opt into v2 downstream. That reduces long-term need for shim.

morgan: Noted. I'll update the RFC follow-up doc with these steps and owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
